-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 130. Success value 80. 3x magic damage (Fire).

-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
